4826-5531-5694-5913-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
4826-5531-5694-5913-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Pinnacle Monk and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Pinnacle Monk and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat.
4826-5531-5694-5913-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Pinnacle Monk and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

5310-5929-6879-8095.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
5310-5929-6879-8095.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more lore counters on it

880-3875-7885.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Tireless Provisioner and Down in the Valley trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Down in the Valley trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1580-2438-3220-4871.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

215-527-1251.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 6 or greater.
215-527-1251.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

423-1257-1437-3257--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-1257-1437-3257--85.description:
Cast Walking Atlas by paying {2}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Walking Atlas spell three times.
Resolve the first Walking Atlas copy.
Activate the Walking Atlas token by tapping it, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

4067-5527-6281-7327.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Clues.
4067-5527-6281-7327.description:
Activate Five Hundred Year Diary by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Ragamuffin Raptor.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Ragamuffin Raptor that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Ragamuffin Raptor token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ragamuffin Raptor from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Five Hundred Year Diary.
Repeat.

2730-5147-5237.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Renegade Rallier.
When Renegade Rallier dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Renegade Rallier from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Renegade Rallier enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Renegade Rallier
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

2231-4871-5220-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2231-4871-5220-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

950-5921-5970-6633.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Fatestitcher.
Activate one of the Fatestitcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Fatestitcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2366-4452-6797-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-4452-6797-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 3.

967-3809-5184-5256-7087.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

413-3305-3817.description:
Cast Body Launderer by paying {2}{B}{B}. 
When Body Launderer enters, Blasting Station triggers.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing Body Launderer to connive.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 3.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger from step 2, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller trigger, returning Body Launderer from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat steps 2 through 6 one additional time.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 7.
Repeat from step 7.

5636-5742-5743-6753.description:
Activate Psychic Frog by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Psychic Frog ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

81-3693-6593.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
81-3693-6593.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista if desired.

2178-3362-5256-6542.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken Dragon with mana value 6.
2178-3362-5256-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken Dragon with mana value 6.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bladewing enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the Dragon with mana value 6 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Bladewing.
When Bladewing dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1247-5963-5984.notablePrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
1247-5963-5984.description:
Activate Marvin using Moonscarred Werewolf's ability by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

1409-1741.notablePrerequisites:
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Cloud of Faeries.
You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
1409-1741.description:
Activate up to two lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Cloud of Faeries by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Cloud of Faeries trigger, untapping the two lands.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Cloud of Faeries.
Repeat.

176-2511-5522.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other non-Spirit creature.
176-2511-5522.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing any other non-Spirit creature.
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token that enters the battlefield as a copy of Essence of the Wild.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

132-198-549-4687.easyPrerequisites: Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
132-198-549-4687.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Myr Welder and adding {G} or {U} for each charge counter on Myr Welder.
Activate Myr Welder using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, targeting any permanent.
Repeat.

803-2178-3413-4170.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Thornbite Staff attached to Fain.
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
"Human" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-2178-3413-4170.description:
Activate Fain's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Xathrid Necromancer and Fain trigger.
Resolve the Xathrid Necromancer trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Fain trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Fain ability from step 1, putting two +1/+1 counters on a creature you control.
Repeat.

4447-4781.notablePrerequisites:
Assault Suit attached to Dandân.
A player controls no Islands.
4447-4781.description:
If needed, give control of Dandân to an opponent who controls no Islands.
When Dandân's controller controls no Islands, Dandân triggers, causing them to sacrifice it.
However, Dandân cannot be sacrificed due to Assault Suit.
Dandân triggers again, creating a mandatory infinite loop that causes the game to end in a draw.

500-2743-4772.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Biovisionary and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
End your turn.
All the Biovisionaries trigger.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, winning the game.

3995-4684-5268.notablePrerequisites:
Horseshoe Crab does not have summoning sickness.
Utopia Vow attached to Horseshoe Crab.
3995-4684-5268.description:
Activate Horseshoe Crab by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Horseshoe Crab by paying {U}, untapping Horseshoe Crab.
Mesmeric Orb triggers, causing you to mill a card.
Repeat.

2060-2313-2854-3977.notablePrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds has 2 or 3 lore counters on it.
2060-2313-2854-3977.description:
Cast Horned Kavu, putting 2 +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler with Showdown of the Skalds.
Remove 2 +1/+1 counter from Crystalline Crawler to add {R}{G}.
Horned Kavu triggers, returning itself to your hand.
Repeat.

404-647-1521-2105.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
404-647-1521-2105.description:
Declare Flamerush Rider, Combat Celebrant and Ghired as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant, Ghired's second ability and Flamerush Rider trigger.
Resolve the Flamerush Rider trigger, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant that is tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Ghired trigger, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase, and declare the Combat Celebrant token created in step 4 and Ghired as attackers, choosing to exert the Combat Celebrant token as it attacks.
Repeat from step 4.
Optionally, you may also attack with Flamerush Rider to get infinite copies of any other attacking creatures you control.

1209-1819-3244.description:
Cast Morality Shift by paying {5}{B}{B}, exchanging your graveyard and library.
Syr Konrad triggers once for each creature card that left your graveyard and once for each creature card put into your graveyard; Kozilek also triggers.
Resolve Kozilek's trigger, shuffling your graveyard into your library.
Syr Konrad triggers an additional time for each creature card that left your graveyard.
Resolve all of Syr Konrad's triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent for each one.
